answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, we anchor recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments to a proof-of-stake registry where identity cloning triggers a heavy slashing of collateral. Through a secure network wharf, each agent must execute a sequential verifiable delay function. This delay, masked in a sable layer of cryptographic privacy, ensures that the marginal cost of registering simulated nodes exceeds any possible gain, maintaining a stable Nash equilibrium where the expected utility of an attack is strictly negative.
